base_result: R50G21 eliminated RUP6_DROP_HUB as a surviving V7 edge ancestry and reduced the surviving V7 hub-cycle class to ALL_DIRECT5_ONLY.
source_level_reduction: For a DIRECT5 edge v->h, the direct exact-DP width5 clause C_v contains exactly the five source variables other than v and h.
The certified opposite-v parent pair that generates C_v omits h from both parents and has one of exactly three R50G14 geometries: 4x3 disjoint, 3x4 disjoint, or 4x4 with one residual overlap.
Therefore an ALL_DIRECT5 hub cycle is also a parent-omission cycle: every edge v->h carries an exact opposite-v parent pair whose residual union is V\{v,h} and whose two parents both omit h.
An all-doors-closed V7 source must additionally make every pivot R47J-unsafe and every alternate pivot R49H-unauthorized/R47J-unsafe, so a parent-omission cycle alone is not a counterexample.

frozen_family.purpose: exact counterexample discovery and rejection diagnosis only; finite no-find is not a universal proof
frozen_family.hub_maps: for cycle length k=2..7: 1->2->...->k->1 and each tail vertex k+1..7 points to 1
frozen_family.ordering: cycle_length ascending, sign_mask ascending, geometry mode in listed order, split_rotation ascending
frozen_family.stop_rule: continue through entire frozen family unless an explicit local all-doors-closed counterexample is found; if found, emit full exact ledger and stop

required_exact_checks: canonical W<=4 source over exactly seven variables
for every pivot v, the frozen designated parent pair is present and R50G14 classifies the target as DIRECT5 with the declared hub
first frozen R33 microstep is immediate BVE escape on pivot 1
exact R49H/R47J door audit on all seven pivots for applicable candidates
if all doors close, emit full hub map/cycle, all seven R47J independent replays, all alternate door ledgers and reachability status separately
